Commentary.Commentary: For his brilliant bowling display, Usman Qadir has been named the Man of the Match as well as the Man of the Series. That is it from this game. Pakistan whitewash Zimbabwe 3-0 in the T20I series and they also won the ODI series 2-1. Zimbabwe go home with just an ODI win. Pakistan will take confidence from this white ball series as they will now go to New Zealand for a full fledged tour starting from 18th December, 2020. Till then, stay safe, take care and goodbye!

Earlier in the evening after winning the toss and batting first, Zimbabwe never got going as Pakistan bowling led by Usman Qadir ran riot and restricted Zimbabwe to a minimal score of 129 on a batting track. Usman's spin just spun a web around Zimbabwe and his 4-fer never let the tourists off the hook.

No fairytale ending for Elton Chigumbura as he bids adieu to international cricket with a painful loss. Zimbabwe succumbed to yet another defeat. Cannot blame the Zimbabwe bowlers as they hardly had any runs to play with in a batting friendly track. Barring one wicket a piece for Milton Shumba and Wellington Masakadza, there was hardly anything from the Zimbabwe bowlers as they were outclassed yet again.

Chasing 130 on a track that is lovely to bat on was hardly going to be a challenge. They needed a solid start and though they were slow off the blocks, Abdullah Shafique gathered pace as the innings progressed. Khushdil Shah came out with an intent to wrap it up early and so he did with his blistering cameo. The only cause of small dent in an otherwise clinical series with the bat would be Fakhar Zaman's form.

Another easy chase for the home side and unlike the ODIs, Pakistan have thoroughly dominated Zimbabwe in an one-sided series, clean sweeping the tourists, 3-0. Pakistan continue their dominance over Zimabwe in the shortest format of the game making it 14 in 14 in their last 14 games.

SIX! Khushdil Shah ends it in grand style. Slower ball on off and middle, Khushdil Shah lofts it mightily over deep mid-wicket. Pakistan win by 8 wickets and whitewash Zimbabwe in the T20I series 3-0.
Full and around off, driven to mid off for a dot.
Faraz Akram is back on.
Flatter on middle and leg, tucked through the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Full and around off, Khushdil lofts it over the bowler's head, to the long on boundary. Not very far away are Pakistan from a victory here.

An appeal for LBW but nothing results. Going down the leg side. Flatter ball on middle and leg, Khushdil looks to tuck it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows but to no avail.
WIDE! Ryan slips one down the leg side, Shah lets it be. Wided.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Khushdil heaves it over mid-wicket. It falls short of Wesley there and the batters take a couple.
Full and around off, driven to long off for a single.
FOUR! Beautifully struck. Full and around off, Abdullah Shafique goes inside out, through the covers, through the carpet. Races away for a boundary, the ball.
A dot to end the over. Flatter outside off, Shah pushes this to covers. 19 runs needed in 36 balls now.

FOUR! Cut and cut very well by Shah! What a cameo this has been from him! His first two sixes were on the leg side and this boundary is to the off side. Flatter outside off, Khushdil rocks on his back foot and punches this to the deep backward point region for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle, Abdullah eases this towards long on for a single.
A full toss on off, Shah heaves this one towards long on for a single. 13 runs off the first three balls.
SIX! Back-to-back boundaries for Shah! Glorious shot! Loopy on middle, Shah skips down the track and hammers this one over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Wonderful batting.
SIX! What a shot! He has hammered this one for a biggie! A juicy full toss on middle, Shah dances down the track and dispatches this one over the deep mid-wicket region for a biggie.
FOUR! Lovely cut shot! Short and width on offer, Shafique goes back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
On off, cut to point off the back foot.
Flighted on off, pushed down to mid-wicket. A dot.
This time he flicks through the mid-wicket region again, but it is straight to the fielder. So, just the single.
FOUR! That is a great shot. Full and on middle, he flicks this through mid-wicket for a glorious boundary.
On off, pushed to cover.
FOUR! In the air.... but just over the inner ring. Floated around off, Abdullah Shafique comes forward and lofts it just over the man at cover. The ball races away for a boundary.
A single as this is eased down to long on for one.
Khushdil Shah strides out into the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Zimbabwe will take that wicket. Haider Ali is not happy with himself there. Floated around off, Haider prods forward to block. The ball takes a faint outside edge and goes to the keeper. Brendan Taylor takes it and Zimbabwe appeal for the caught behind. Haider Ali though does not wait for the umpire's signal, he walks off straightaway.
On off, blocked.
FOUR! He is in glorious form, Ali. Short and wide, Ali rocks back and punches it through the covers, wide of the man at cover. A boundary results.
Tossed up around off, pushed back to the bowler.
WIDE! Way outside off, the batter lets it be.
Some more spin! Milton Shumba to bowl now.
On the shorter side on off, the batsman goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
On off, pushed to cover.
On off, Ali looked to cut this one but is beaten.
Flighted on off, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
On the shorter side on leg, glanced to mid-wicket who fumbles. A comfortable two.
On off, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Ryan Burl is introduced into the attack.
Flatter on off, driven through mid on for a single. 61 needed in the last 10 overs.
Flatter ball outside off, punched wide of the bowler, to long off. A single.
Flighted around off, pushed down to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, eased to mid on for a dot.
Follows the boundary with a single by pushing this down to long on for a single.
SIX! A prime example of talent meeting opportunity this young man is. Floated on off, Ali clears his front leg and powers it miles over deep mid-wicket.
On off, pushed down to long on for one.
SIX! There he goes again, this time, Haider. Full on middle and leg, he strokes it uppishly and way over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Follows the six with a single by nudging this towards mid-wicket for one.
SIX! Abdullah plays good strong shots down the ground like that. 50 up for Pakistan as well. Floated around off, he comes down and lofts it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
On off, blocked.
Flatter on off, driven down to long off for a single.
Flatter around off, steered to short third man for a single and Ali will retain the strike for the next over.
Flatter on middle, Ali tucks this to mid-wicket.

Quicker and sliding into the batter, Ali looks to sweep but misses and it hits him on the pads. An appeal but nothing from the umpire. It looked to be pitching outside leg and hence no review is taken.
On middle and leg, tucked to square leg for another single.
Flatter on middle, punched towards long on for a single.
LEG BYE! Flatter on the pads, Ali flicks this towards the fine leg region. The batters collect a couple.
Wesley Madhevere into the attack now.
Ali eases this down towards long off for a single.
Who's next for Pakistan? Haider Ali it is.

OUT! CAUGHT! The first wicket falls for Pakistan and it is the Fakhar Zaman who walks back now. Spin does the trick for Zimbabwe. Zaman's struggles with the bat continue as he goes back with a low score. Floated on middle, Zaman dances down the track and lofts this one towards the deep mid-wicket region, he does not time it well and Madhevere makes no mistake with this one.
Flighted around off, Shafque looks to go over the off side but this one comes off the inner half and goes towards long on for a single.
Floated on off, blocked to the leg side.
Short ball on the pads, tucked to short fine leg for a quick single.
Flatter around off, Abdullah rocks back and punches this to the deep cover region for a single.
Over to spin as Wellington Masakadza is into the attack now.
A good way to end the over for Akram! A yorker on middle, dug out to the leg side. Pakistan are at 36/0 at the end of the Powerplay.
On a full length on middle, Shafique tucks this to the right of mid-wicket and the fielder does well to stop this one. A single in the end.
Another missed opportunity! Another full toss, another dot! A full toss outside off, Abdullah pushes this to the man at mid off.
PLAY AND A MISS! A slow leg cutter around off, Shafique strides forward and looks to heave this one away but only connects his bat with thin air.
On off on a good length, Zaman drives this to the deep cover region to exchange ends.
Zaman misses out on this! This was a juicy full toss outside off, Fakhar plays this to covers.
A couple to end the over! On middle, Abdullah flicks this to deep square leg for a couple.
WIDE! Good length down the leg side, Abdullah looks to tuck this away but misses. Wided.
Good length ball on off, Zaman works this to the left of mid on and collect a single.
WIDE! Way outside off, Zaman leaves it alone. The umpire signals this as a wide.

SIX! First six of the innings and it is off Zaman's willow! He has got his dancing shoes on, alright. On a good length on middle, Zaman dances down the track and lofts this one handsomely over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
On middle, flicked towards mid-wicket for one.
IN THE AIR...SAFE! On a good length around off, Shafique slashes this over covers and luckily for him, it lands safe. The batters complete the second run.
A quick single! On off on a good length, Zaman pushes this towards mid off and the batters take a quick single. There is a throw at the non-striker's end and it is hit but Zaman was safely in.
Donald Tiripano replaces Muzarabani into the attack now.
Good length on off, Zaman taps this towards point and the batters collect a quick single.
On a good length around the pads, tucked to the man at short fine leg.
Fullish length ball on off, Shaifque digs this one out towards deep square leg to cross ends for a single.
WIDE! Slips this down the leg side, Shafique looks to flick but misses. Wided.
BEATEN! Lovely shape by the bowler! Back of a length ball outside off, Shafique looks to push this to the off side but he misses this one completely.
A slower full toss outside off, Abdullah pushes this to covers.
Faraz starts off with a full length ball around off, Zaman works this towards mid off and the batters scamper through for the single.
Faraz Akram to bowl now.
On middle, blocked well.
Zaman pushes this to the on side for a single.

DROPPED! It is the captain, Chibhabha who drops this one! It should have been taken as it was not the hardest catch out there! Back of a length ball outside off, Zaman looks to cut this one but with the extra bouce on offer, it kisses his outside edge and goes towards the captain at first slip who catches it but then it pops out of his hands.
FOUR! Nicely timed! In the gap and four! Back of a length delivery around off, Zaman cuts this past the diving fielder at point and it runs away to the ropes.
Back of a length delivery around off, Zaman pushes this to the on side.
Short ball on middle, Shafique hops and works it to square leg for a single.
Full on off, flicked but straight to short mid-wicket. Just 2 runs from that over.
Full on off, driven down to mid off.
On middle, blocked.
An appeal for LBW but not given. Fullish and on middle and leg, Zaman misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. An appeal follows but to no avail.
Full on off, driven back to the bowler.
On middle, flicked towards deep square leg for a couple. Fakhar is extremely quick and comes back for the second.
Who will partner Muzarabani with the new ball? It is Donald Tiripano.
FOUR! Stylishly played. Full and on middle and leg, Abdullah flicks it through square leg and the ball races away for a boundary.
Full and around off, driven to mid on for a single.
Outside off, nudged to third man for a single.
Almost a feather edge there. Back of a length ball around off, extra bit of pace and bounce, the batsman initially looked to play but later pulls away.
Full and around off, Fakhar defends it to the off side and takes a quick single.
On a length outside off, dragged down to mid on.
We are back for the chase! The openers of Pakistan, Fakhar Zaman and Abdullah Shafique stride out into the middle. Blessing Muzarabani will start proceedings with the ball for Zimbabwe. Here we go...
